name: fafb783-steering
kind: Data-derived structure: identities, types, sides, predicted transmitters and synapse counts. Signs, gains and dynamics are runtime assumptions of the model that loads it.

provenance.coverage: DNa01, DNa02, DNp09 and their presynaptic partners up to 2 hops back, connections with at least 5 synapses, at most 4000 neurons
provenance.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (FlyWire public-release terms): non-commercial use only
provenance.attribution: FlyWire Consortium (Princeton University and collaborating labs) for the FAFB/FlyWire reconstruction and annotations; Eckstein et al. for transmitter predictions; Bates/Lee lab for the harmonized metadata; Shiu et al. for the v783 connectivity table.
